description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans silo behavior during ungraceful shutdowns, specifically testing how outstanding grain requests are affected when a silo is killed unexpectedly. It defines a test class 'SilosStopTests' with configuration setup and a test method 'SiloUngracefulShutdown_OutstandingRequestsBreak' that simulates silo failure and verifies request handling.

classes.name: SilosStopTests
classes.description: A test class for simulating and verifying the behavior of Orleans silos during ungraceful shutdowns, focusing on the impact on ongoing grain requests.

classes.name: BuilderConfigurator
classes.description: A nested class implementing configuration interfaces to set up silo and client options for testing.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures silo options such as missed probes limit, death declaration votes, and table refresh timeout, as well as setting up homogenous silos for testing.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the client builder to use static clustering with a specified endpoint based on test cluster options.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Overrides the test cluster configuration to add the custom configurator for silos and clients.

methods.name: SiloUngracefulShutdown_OutstandingRequestsBreak
methods.description: Test method that kills a secondary silo during a long-running grain call and asserts that a SiloUnavailableException is thrown.

methods.name: GetGrainOnTargetSilo
methods.description: Helper method to retrieve a grain instance located on a specific silo, retrying multiple times to ensure correct placement.
